_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/journal-redesigned.$QJUI_CUSTOM_VERSION_TEXT_HELP: Leave blank to use the original SKSE version text. The Hide version text setting takes priority.
line:menu_translation/journal-redesigned.$QJUI_DIRECT_QUIT_HELP: Selecting Quit opens directly the "Quit to Desktop" confirmation.
line:menu_translation/journal-redesigned.$QJUI_HIDE_VERSION_TEXT_HELP: Hides the SKSE version text in the lower-left corner of the System page.
line:menu_translation/journal-redesigned.$QJUI_MISC_OBJECTIVES_KEY_HELP: Keyboard shortcut to open miscellaneous objectives and return to quests. Default: Q. Clear the binding to use only the clickable hint or gamepad X. Journal navigation/action keys and numpad keys are unavailable. Gamepad controls are unchanged.
line:menu_translation/journal-redesigned.$QJUI_MISC_OBJECTIVES_KEY_INVALID: Choose another keyboard key or clear the binding. This key is reserved by the journal or is not supported. The invalid binding was not applied.
line:menu_translation/journal-redesigned.$QJUI_ROW_HIDDEN_HELP: Set to on to hide this row from the journal. Its position and custom name are preserved.
line:menu_translation/journal-redesigned.$QJUI_ROW_RENAME_HELP: Leave blank to use the vanilla label.
line:menu_translation/journal-redesigned.$QJUI_STATS_ROW_MENU_HELP: The selected translated category occupies this position. Choosing another category swaps both categories and keeps their visibility and custom names attached.
line:menu_translation/journal-redesigned.$QJUI_SYSTEM_ROW_MENU_HELP: The selected translated row occupies this position. Choosing another row swaps both rows and keeps their visibility and custom names attached.
